links.claim: CTCF is the only TF with a ChIP-seq peak containing this variant in the provided evidence, but that peak is only in LNCAP; HepG2 has no CTCF peak over the variant. No QBiC-SELEX model is provided for CTCF, so the alt-more-strongly direction is speculative and not established by an allele-specific binding assay.

The variant does not overlap a cCRE; the nearest cCRE is 1544 bp away. The only CTCF peak containing the variant is LNCAP-specific, so this is at best a weak non-liver CTCF-associated element, not a supported liver regulatory element.

FAM110B is the closest protein-coding gene at 420.6 kb upstream. E09 provides only a gene-level literature association between FAM110B and a pravastatin/cardiovascular study, not evidence that this variant regulates FAM110B; E12 reports no Open Targets association between FAM110B and free cholesterol in large LDL.

CTCF is expressed in Hep 3B2.1-7 at 32.01 TPM, but the matching HepG2 biosample has zero CTCF ChIP-seq peaks over the variant; this weakens a liver-specific CTCF mechanism and confines the only occupancy signal to a non-liver context.

No GTEx liver eQTL and no GTEx single-tissue eQTL are reported for this variant, and GWAS Catalog and Open Targets have no association; the LDL phenotype link is therefore not demonstrated and relies only on a distant gene-level literature hit.
